messages:
jordan: Uploading new model artifacts for TrackNet-v2 (weights + tokenizer). Need an ingestion run for provenance, KMS signing, and registry placement. Uploaded to s3://redwood-ingest/temp/tracknet-v2/ — can someone take ownership?

sam: I can own the ingest flow. Plan: 1) validate checksums, 2) sign manifest with KMS key, 3) move to registry bucket with object-tagging + retention. Assign me the key id and confirm required tags.

emily: Heads up — once in registry I'll queue quantization experiments (4-bit/8-bit) and run the eval harness. Please include a sample prompt set and a short eval checklist in the manifest.

ana: small note: metadata MUST include model_id, semantic_version, training_commit, dataset_hash, license, and PII_flag. If PII_flag=true we need DSR workflow. Also set s3:ObjectLock if retention required.

sam: copying planned commands for quick reference:
```
# download artifacts
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-ingest/temp/tracknet-v2/weights.pt ./weights.pt --region us-west-2
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-ingest/temp/tracknet-v2/tokenizer.json ./tokenizer.json
# compute checksums
sha256sum weights.pt > weights.sha256
sha256sum tokenizer.json > tokenizer.sha256
# sign manifest with KMS
aws kms sign --key-id alias/model-ingest-key --message fileb://manifest.json --output text --region us-west-2 > manifest.sig
# move to registry
aws s3 mv s3://redwood-ingest/temp/tracknet-v2/ s3://redwood-registry/models/tracknet-v2/ --recursive --region us-west-2
```

jordan: @sam use KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345. Also require manifest to include `quant_candidates` array and `eval_prompts` pointer (s3 path).

sam: noted. I'll produce a signed ledger entry too (ledger.json) with fields: model_id, version, artifacts:[{path,sha256,size}], signer_kms_key, timestamp, provenance_notes. Will store ledger at s3://redwood-registry/ledgers/tracknet-v2/ledger-1784209876.json and tag with `verified:true`.

artifact-bot: Automated check: manifest.json found, but tokenizer.json missing object tag `tokenizer_version`. Failing pre-move.

ana: @sam quick fix: add object tags during mv step, e.g. `--tagging "model_id=tracknet-v2&tokenizer_version=1.2&pii=false"`. Also set `x-amz-server-side-encryption:aws:kms` header where appropriate.

sam: done. I'll run the full ingest now. Posting short logfile after run.

sam: log snippet:
```
[1784209950] sha256(weights.pt)=f3b9c9a1... OK
[1784209960] sha256(tokenizer.json)=0a7e5c3b... OK
[1784210050] manifest.json signed with key abcd-ef01-2345 -> signature: MEUCIQ...
[1784210100] moved artifacts to s3://redwood-registry/models/tracknet-v2/ with tagging
[1784210200] ledger written to s3://redwood-registry/ledgers/tracknet-v2/ledger-1784209876.json
```

emily: thanks — I'll kick off quant experiments once the registry objects are readable by the quant cluster. Sam, please set ACL to allow `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/quant-runner` read access.

sam: ACL set and IAM role granted. Also opened a GH PR with manifest schema updates and a short runbook for oncall: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-registry/pull/402

jordan: perfect. Post-ingest checklist for tracking: [ ] manifest signed, [ ] ledger present, [ ] object tags set, [ ] kms key id recorded, [ ] acl for quant runner, [ ] eval prompts included. Mark when done.

emily: marking eval prompts included — s3://redwood-evals/tracknet-v2/promptset-v1.json

sam: all ingest steps complete. Marking checkboxes and adding final provenance note in ledger. :white_check_mark:

artifact-bot: Automated verification: ledger and manifest signatures valid; object tags present; retention=none; encryption=aws:kms. Verification timestamp: 1784213450

jordan: awesome — thanks everyone. Emily will report quant/regression results tomorrow. Closing thread but keeping ledger reference in PR.
